name: Creamy Mushroom Stroganoff with Wild Rice and Butter Beans

components.name: Mushroom & Butter Bean Stroganoff

ingredients.name: Canned butter beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Saute onion in olive oil for 5 minutes, then add garlic and paprika.
Turn heat high, fry sliced mushrooms in batches until their released water reduces and edges brown.
Add drained butter beans, vegetable stock and verified vegetarian Worcestershire; simmer 8-10 minutes.
Remove pan from direct heat before stirring in sour cream; do not boil hard afterward. Add parsley.
Pack four portions with separate rice; the butter beans are a measured UNHANGRY protein addition absent from the referenced recipe.

components.name: Wild Rice Mix

ingredients.name: Dry wild/brown rice mix, not microwave pouch
Water for rice, adjust only for brand instructions

steps: Cook dry wild/brown rice mix using the packet-recommended method with measured water; this can take 35-50 minutes.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Adds butter beans to make the published relatively light stroganoff a substantial meal. Source handling: Source technique/reference; measured UNHANGRY complete-meal adaptation.
Planning: Dry wild rice requires longer than pouch rice.
Freezer: sauce can separate after freezing; freeze rice and mushroom-bean base without sour cream if possible
Dietary: Contains dairy; conventional Worcestershire often has anchovies, use vegetarian labelled one.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
